channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Creek Park
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Creek Park (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Creek Park: Rec and Park's project page (re-read October 17, 2026) gives the…
item.description: Rec and Park's project page (re-read October 17, 2026) gives the South Extension's construction start as 'Late 2026 / Early 2027' and the public opening as 'TBD'. This record showed only '~2026'; it now shows the window, with the same wording as the P2 and P8 records, so Coming up lists the start once. The date is an expected date, and no source read says construction has started. Source: San Francisco Recreation and Parks Department, Mission Creek Park South Extension Project (https://sfrecpark.org/1833/Mission-Creek-Park-South-Extension-Proje), Estimated Project Schedule: "Construction begins , Late 2026 / Early 2027"; "Open to the Public , TBD".
item.source: San Francisco Recreation and Parks Department, Mission Creek Park South Extension Project (https://sfrecpark.org/1833/Mission-Creek-Park-South-Extension-Proje), Estimated Project Schedule: "Construction begins , Late 2026 / Early 2027"; "Open to the Public , TBD"

item.title: Correction · Mission Creek Park: OCII's September 2023 presentation says Rec and Park "will…
item.description: OCII's September 2023 presentation says Rec and Park "will manage" a list of parcels, with P2/P8 among those to be managed "when built"; it does not say any parcel was already managed. OCII's November 2024 update titles one slide "MISSION CREEK PARK (P3)" while its map labels P1, P2 & P8 and P3 separately. Source: https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Item%202%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Transition.pdf; https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2024-11/Item%205%20-%20Remaining%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Parcels%20Update.pdf.

item.title: Correction · Mission Creek Park: Mission Creek Park is marked complete for the built park only
item.description: Mission Creek Park is marked complete for the built park only. The mapped area also covers land for the planned Mission Creek Park South Extension (parcels P2 and P8), where Rec & Park expects construction to begin in late 2026 or early 2027 and gives no opening date. The outline itself has not changed. Source: SF Recreation and Park Department, Mission Creek Park South Extension Project (https://sfrecpark.org/1833/Mission-Creek-Park-South-Extension-Proje).

item.title: Correction · Mission Creek Park: The summary called the park a waterfront park on Mission Creek's…
item.description: The summary called the park a waterfront park on Mission Creek's south bank; SF Rec & Park describes Mission Creek Park (North and South), and the record's map shape sits largely on the north/west bank, so the summary now follows Rec & Park's description. The P3 milestone said the extension is west of Fourth Street; Potrero View puts the existing park west of Fourth Street and says P3 extends it toward China Basin Park, so that phrase was removed and the fall-2021 target now cites Potrero View. 'One of the earliest parcels' now cites SF Rec & Park's Workshop 3 timeline (first parks opened at Mission Creek P1 and Mission Bay Commons P17 in 2002), which also supports the P1 opening year in the map notes. The July 1, 2023 management change no longer says 'from OCII/the Port' (the Rec & Park page does not say that), and the map notes no longer credit the Rec & Park page with an opening date. The caveat about other OpenStreetMap shapes is marked as unchecked, and the pump-station identification (Assessor blklot 3806006 at 455 Berry St confirmed) is noted as Pier & Point's own. The OCII deck's 'CAC Item 2' label came from a file name and was dropped from the source title, and the Wikimedia aerial credit names only the Commons username Firstcultural. Source: SF Rec & Park, Mission Creek Park (North and South) (https://sfrecpark.org/Facilities/Facility/Details/Mission-Creek-Park-North-and-South-449); Potrero View, 2021-05 (https://www.potreroview.net/mission-creek-park-p3-will-open-this-fall/); SF Rec & Park, Mission Bay Future Parks Workshop 3 presentation, 2025-04-29 (https://sfrecpark.org/DocumentCenter/View/25986/20250429-PRESENTATION-Workshop-3); OCII, Mission Bay Parks Open Space transition presentation, 2023-09 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Item%202%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Transition.pdf).
item.source: SF Rec & Park, Mission Creek Park (North and South) (https://sfrecpark.org/Facilities/Facility/Details/Mission-Creek-Park-North-and-South-449); Potrero View, 2021-05 (https://www.potreroview.net/mission-creek-park-p3-will-open-this-fall/); SF Rec & Park, Mission Bay Future Parks Workshop 3 presentation, 2025-04-29 (https://sfrecpark.org/DocumentCenter/View/25986/20250429-PRESENTATION-Workshop-3); OCII, Mission Bay Parks Open Space transition presentation, 2023-09 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Item%202%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Transition.pdf)

item.title: Expected · Mission Creek Park: Construction expected to begin 'Late 2026… (late 2026 or early 2027)
item.description: Construction expected to begin 'Late 2026 / Early 2027' for the Mission Creek Park South Extension (parcels P2 and P8), per Rec and Park's project page, which gives the public opening as 'TBD'; a July 2025 update said construction was expected to begin in 2026 with an 18-month duration (late 2026 or early 2027). Source: San Francisco Recreation and Parks Department; San Francisco Recreation and Parks Department (News Flash), 2025-07-30.
item.source: San Francisco Recreation and Parks Department; San Francisco Recreation and Parks Department (News Flash), 2025-07-30

item.title: Complete · Mission Creek Park: Mission Creek Stormwater Park (the P3 extension, 1.2… (Oct 2022)
item.description: Mission Creek Stormwater Park (the P3 extension, 1.2 acres at 1000 Channel St, bounded by China Basin Channel) completed, per a Landscape Performance Series case study – resolves this project's own prior open question of whether the fall-2021 target opening reported by Potrero View in May 2021 (after a COVID-19 construction pause) actually happened on schedule; it slipped about a year further (Oct 2022). Source: Landscape Architecture Foundation, Landscape Performance Series; Potrero View, 2021-05.
item.source: Landscape Architecture Foundation, Landscape Performance Series; Potrero View, 2021-05

item.title: Under construction · Mission Creek Park: Construction begins on the Mission Creek Park… (~Sep 2019)
item.description: Construction begins on the Mission Creek Park P3 extension (1.65 acres behind One Mission Bay, extending the park to align with China Basin Park), following a mid-2019 permit; substantially complete was originally targeted for end of 2020 (~Sep 2019). Source: Potrero View, 2021-05.
